_comment: Every URL this project needs, in one file. Which mode you run in is set by COHORT_MODE in .env (solo | online), not here - that is a per-machine choice, while this file is shared. Secrets stay in .env too; this file is safe to commit.

paths._comment: Paths appended to a base URL. The same for you and every classmate, so they are declared once here instead of being spelled out in each script and doc.

solo._comment: Everything on your laptop, no tunnel, no classmates needed. `peers` are the OPTIONAL extra copies of this service you can start on other ports to simulate a cohort of one.

online._comment: The live class session. Leave my_base_url blank: online mode falls back to AGENTMESH_BASE_URL from .env (your cloudflared URL), so you set your URL in one place only. Fill my_base_url here just to override that. cohort_index_url is the database REST endpoint: the site at boss.site_url serves the PAGES, but Firebase Hosting cannot proxy the database without Cloud Functions, so machine-readable roster reads go straight to the database.

boss._comment: The cohort coordination site. Ask your instructor for these, or copy them off the signup page. None are secrets - a Firebase web api_key is public by design; the database rules are what protect the data. Leave blank to work without a coordination service.
